Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq rebounds as chip stocks recover from steep losses, rate fears persist
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded as a recovery in chipmakers like Nvidia and AMD lifted the Nasdaq by 1.73%. Stronger-than-expected October jobs data revived concerns regarding a potential December Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Stock Market Live Updates: US stocks rebound as chip stocks recover, Nasdaq gains over 1%
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks rebounded as semiconductor stocks recovered, leading the Nasdaq to gain over 1%. The market recovery drove overall positive movement in trading sessions.

Markets.title: India's 10-year bond posts best week in 7 years, leads emerging Asia as oil slides
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds achieved their best weekly performance in seven years, outperforming other Asian markets as benchmark yields dropped significantly. Falling crude prices following the US midterms attracted foreign investors and relieved pressure on the Reserve Bank of India to maintain high yields.

Markets.title: British Airways parent profit drops on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: British Airways parent company IAG reported a more than 12 percent drop in third-quarter net profit. The decline resulted from soaring fuel costs, engine issues, and flight cancellations linked to the Middle East conflict.

Markets.title: Trump Media's investors lost $2.2 billion while Trump holds $460 million stake
Markets.summary: Trump Media investors have lost $2.2 billion as the company's stock value has plummeted amid stagnant revenue. Meanwhile, Donald Trump still retains a $460 million stake in the struggling social media platform.

Markets.title: Copper price falls for 4th day, heads for worst week since March on AI rout
Markets.summary: Copper prices fell for the fourth consecutive day, heading toward their worst week since March due to declining technology shares and concerns over artificial intelligence investments. Despite tight supply cushioning further losses, the three-month copper rate on the London Metal Exchange dropped to its lowest level since late July.

Geo-Political.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
Geo-Political.summary: Artificial intelligence stocks rebounded after a market sell-off wiped trillions of dollars from their values. Investors had previously sold these shares over concerns that a Democratic election victory would slow AI development.

Geo-Political.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
Geo-Political.summary: Recent midterm election results are already shaping political speculation and strategies for the 2028 presidential race. Analysts have identified four key takeaways from these contests that will influence future White House campaigns.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A bus crash in France resulted in the deaths of one child and one young adult. Multiple other passengers sustained injuries in the accident.

Geo-Political.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
Geo-Political.summary: A new wave of bomb threats has targeted various European airlines. Authorities have not yet found any connection between these airline threats and recent threats made against media outlets.

Geo-Political.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
Geo-Political.summary: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life in prison for the starvation deaths of 191 children in a forest. He had instructed his followers to starve their families so they could meet Jesus.

Geo-Political.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
Geo-Political.summary: A judge has blocked the construction of Donald Trump's planned 250-foot arch despite approval from a federal agency. The Trump administration had intended to begin building the massive structure as early as this week.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to suffer treasury losses during the second quarter. This financial pressure is expected to continue impacting bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds combined. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilot rounds.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran has exempted Indian ships from Strait of Hormuz restrictions to secure critical medicines, energy supplies, and diplomatic support. In return, Tehran expects India to maintain these essential trade flows and diplomatic cooperation despite broader regional tensions.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. This high cost of food is causing financial strain by eroding household savings and increasing borrowing.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Primer | How will the blue tsunami in the US mid-terms benefit India?
Data & Insights.summary: The expectation is that Donald Trump will hold back his aggressive instincts during the Iran war. Instead, he is expected to opt for a negotiated settlement.

Data & Insights.title: Snack makers tweak trade margins, engineer pouches to break  ₹5 pack habit
Data & Insights.summary: Rising costs of ingredients and packaging are squeezing profit margins on cheap entry-level snacks. To counter this, snack makers are pushing larger package sizes and expanding their premium product lines.

India.title: Biryani By Kilo, D-Mart Face Action In Maharashtra Crackdown Ahead Of Diwali
India.summary: Ahead of Diwali, Maharashtra authorities suspended the licenses of quick-commerce platforms Zepto and Blinkit in Mumbai. Popular food chains, including Biryani By Kilo, Tossin Pizza, and Jumbo Burger, also faced action during this crackdown.

India.title: Analysis: From Hospital Bed, Sharad Pawar Keeps Maharashtra Guessing Over NCP-NDA Move
India.summary: Veteran Maharashtra politician Sharad Pawar is currently hospitalized while keeping political observers guessing about his party's potential alliance moves. Pawar has maintained a reputation as one of India's most unpredictable political leaders over the past six decades.

India.title: Delhi College Accountant Duped Of Rs 80 Lakh In 'Boss Fraud'
India.summary: An accountant at Delhi's Chanderprabhu Jain College of Higher Studies and School of Law was cheated out of Rs 80 lakh in a "boss fraud" scam. The incident occurred at the institution located in Narela, which is run by the Rishi Aurobindo Educational Society.

India.title: Man Confronts Tour Operators About Missing Parents. They Beat Him To Death
India.summary: Haider Ansari was beaten to death by tour operators after confronting them about his parents' delayed return from Umrah in Saudi Arabia. His parents had missed their scheduled October 24 return date.

India.title: Oil Companies Reject Karnataka Minister's '30% Ethanol' Charge Over E20 Petrol, Question Testing Method
India.summary: Major Indian oil companies rejected a Karnataka minister's claim that E20 petrol contains 30 percent ethanol. The companies stated that the minister's allegations lacked backing from statutory and technical testing procedures.

India.title: 'E20 Actually Has Over 30% Ethanol': Karnataka Minister Cites Petrol Tests, Demands Consumer Relief Fund
India.summary: Karnataka's Consumer Affairs Minister Rizwan Arshad announced that tests on state petrol samples revealed ethanol levels up to 31.2%, significantly higher than the declared 20%. Following these findings, the minister demanded the establishment of a consumer relief fund.
